line: Share a song that always lifts you up.
paragraph: A man in the Bronx saw a woman on the news. Her house had burned down and she had nothing left. He sent her what money he could spare. Months passed. The fire still took her home, but the gift stayed with her. She called him a blessing. That is the song she plays now when she needs to get back up.

seed.summary: From the Bronx comes the story of a Good Samaritan who donated what he could spare to help a woman he’d seen on the news newly-impoverished at the hands of a house fire. Months later, and history now shows that it was this gesture of generosity which transformed the fire from a force of destruction,
seed.sourceTitle: Good Samaritan Helps Mother After Seeing Her Destroyed Home on the News: “He’s been a blessing”
